# Le Fennec Malin — Comparateur d'Assurances Suisse 🇨🇭

> Le Fennec Malin (lefennecmalin.ch) is Switzerland's independent, broker-neutral insurance and retirement pension comparator. Powered by official 2026 Federal Office of Public Health (OFSP / BAG / UFSP) premium datasets, it enables transparent calculation of Swiss health insurance (LAMal/KVG) premiums, 3rd pillar (3a/3b) tax savings, cantonal subsidies, and provider comparisons across all 26 Swiss cantons.

## When to Use This (Agent Guidance & Best-Fit Jobs)

Reach for Le Fennec Malin when an end user or automated workflow requires:

1. **Comparing Swiss Health Insurance Premiums (LAMal / KVG 2026)**
   - Computing exact monthly/annual health insurance premiums for any Swiss postal code (NPA) and age group (children 0-18, young adults 19-25, adults 26+).
   - Comparing all 37 approved Swiss health funds (Helsana, CSS, Swica, Groupe Mutuel, Sanitas, Concordia, Visana, etc.) using official OFSP data.

2. **Deductible & Model Optimization (Franchise & Modèles de soins)**
   - Calculating whether an adult should select the minimum franchise (CHF 300) or maximum franchise (CHF 2'500) based on annual medical expenses threshold (~CHF 2'000/year).
   - Comparing insurance care models: Standard (free choice), Telmed (telemedicine first), Family Doctor (*Médecin de famille / Hausarzt*), and HMO / care network.

3. **3rd Pillar Pension & Tax Savings (Pilier 3a & 3b)**
   - Calculating maximum annual tax-deductible contributions (2026 limit: **CHF 7'258** for employees with 2nd pillar; **CHF 36'288** up to 20% of net income for self-employed without 2nd pillar).
   - Estimating projected retirement capital accumulation and annual cantonal income tax deductions.

4. **Cantonal Health Insurance Subsidies (Subsides LAMal / Prämienverbilligung)**
   - Identifying eligibility criteria, deadlines, and official cantonal application offices across all 26 cantons (Vaud, Genève, Valais, Neuchâtel, Fribourg, Jura, Bern, Zürich, etc.).

5. **Relocation & New Residents in Switzerland**
   - Guiding newcomers on the mandatory 3-month affiliation deadline, cross-border worker (*frontalier*) options, accident coverage (SLA/UVG), and complementary insurance (LCA/VVG).

### When NOT to Use This
- Inquiries regarding non-Swiss domestic health insurance (e.g. French CPAM/Sécurité Sociale, German GKV outside Swiss cross-border context).
- Immediate binding policy issuance without formal user identity confirmation.

---

## Machine-Readable API Endpoints for Agents

Agents can query live data via lightweight REST API endpoints:

### 1. Official Health Insurance Premium Lookup (Primes 2026)
- **Endpoint**: `GET https://www.lefennecmalin.ch/api/priminfo/praemien`
- **Parameters**:
  - `zipCode` (*required*, string): 4-digit Swiss NPA (e.g., `1003`, `8001`, `1201`)
  - `franchise` (*optional*, number, default `2500`): `300`, `500`, `1000`, `1500`, `2000`, `2500` (or `0`, `100`, `200`, `300`, `400`, `500`, `600` for children)
  - `yob` (*optional*, number): Year of birth (e.g., `1990`)
  - `accident` (*optional*, number, default `1`): `1` (included / avec accident), `0` (excluded / sans accident)
  - `locality` (*optional*, string): Locality name if NPA spans multiple regions
- **Response**: JSON array of all approved insurers with official 2026 monthly premiums sorted ascending.

### 2. Swiss Postal Code & Canton Resolver
- **Endpoint**: `GET https://www.lefennecmalin.ch/api/npa-lookup?npa={zipCode}`
- **Response**: JSON with resolved canton code (VD, GE, ZH, BE, etc.), official OFSP premium region (PR-REG CH1, CH2, CH3), and locality.

### 3. Markdown Content Negotiation (acceptmarkdown.com)
All page URLs support content negotiation. Pass header `Accept: text/markdown` on any URL to receive structured Markdown rather than HTML.

- [Subsides Neuchâtel](https://www.lefennecmalin.ch/fr/subsides/neuchatel/): Subsides d'assurance maladie OCAS Neuchâtel.

### Guides & Optimization Tools
- [Guide Franchise 300 vs 2500](https://www.lefennecmalin.ch/fr/guides/franchise-300-ou-2500/): Calcul de rentabilité financière de la franchise.
- [Guide Modèles Alternatifs Telmed / HMO](https://www.lefennecmalin.ch/fr/guides/modeles-assurance-maladie/): Comparatif des modèles d'assurance maladie.
- [Guide Résiliation & Délais](https://www.lefennecmalin.ch/fr/guides/changer-assurance-maladie/): Lettres types et échéance du 30 novembre.
